## Summary

Describe the user/operator outcome and why this change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] `make lint`, `make test`, and relevant integration tests pass
- [ ] Operator-visible behavior is documented in `README.MD`
- [ ] No secret, key, database, binary, package, or support bundle is committed

## Compatibility and recovery

- [ ] API/Protobuf compatibility checked, or not applicable
- [ ] Migration, backup, rollback, and N/N-1 behavior covered, or not applicable
- [ ] Privileged/security boundary and threat model reviewed, or not applicable
- [ ] Removal/purge remains non-destructive by default
